text:
Nora: Heads-up — Ember (preview) is soft-enrolled but usage is almost nil. Finance flagged a 60-day renewal risk unless we demonstrate onboarding momentum. Can we coordinate a concise enablement + feedback plan this week? :warning:
Priya: I can run a 40m hands-on session + 20m Q&A. Need dev API keys, a tiny sample dataset, and their target qps. Tue/Wed morning best for me.
Sam: I can do a short pre-call checklist and a post-call 3-question survey. Would like to capture: first successful inference, median latency, error rate, tokens/day.
Leo: Quick ask — can we add an opt-in response header X-RW-LATENCY in SDK to help their SREs? Minimal surface, toggle via preview flag.
Priya: That would help troubleshooting and accelerate fixes (batching / quantization recs).
Nora: Action list: (1) Sam — draft agenda + survey; (2) Jenna — get keys / confirm dev token (Jenna is on the customer thread); (3) Leo — feasibility on latency header; (4) Priya — calendar + run session; (5) Nora — monitor renewal tag + escalate if no progress in 48h.
Sam: Draft agenda:
- 10m intros + success criteria
- 20m integration (keys, minimal snippet, S3 role)
- 15m run a sample inference together
- 15m Q&A + feedback
Sam: Survey (post-session): 1) How clear was the integration guide? (1-5) 2) Biggest blocker? (free text) 3) Likelihood to proceed to prod in 30d? (1-5)
Leo: Feasibility: can add X-RW-LATENCY header for preview orgs by tomorrow EOD. Will open a tiny PR and mark it behind preview-telemetry.
Priya: If we have latency and error codes we can make an immediate tuning checklist for them during the call.
Nora: Also asked legal about a temp DPA exception for dev tokens; awaiting reply. If LEGAL stalls >24h we escalate to AE.
onboarding-bot: Reminder set: "Ember preview enablement" Wed 9:30 AM - invite queued.
Sam: I will triage survey responses first-pass (classify docs / infra / product) and hand product asks to Leo.
Nora: Thanks — if keys land by EOD tomorrow we target Wed. Ill update renewal risk after the session if adoption looks healthy. If no keys, escalate to AE at 48h. :rotating_light:
